summary.text: Ben Franklin is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 88 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A U.S. Air Force veteran, he has worked as a small business owner and director of operations.

paragraphs.text: Ben Franklin was born in Carthage, Illinois, and graduated from Keokuk High School.
He began serving in the U.S. Air Force in 2008 and earned a bachelor's degree from Trident University International in 2020.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner and director of operations.
Franklin took office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Republican John Macco in District 88.

In the 2025-2026 session he serves as vice-chair of the Veterans and Military Affairs Committee and sits on the Corrections, Criminal Justice and Public Safety, Jobs and the Economy, Urban Revitalization, and Ways and Means committees.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Franklin said he had settled in De Pere after his Air Force service, and he listed helping families and communities prosper, defending constitutional rights and parental rights, and safe communities and a secure border as key campaign messages.
